jobs.description: Introduction/About usAs Global Salesforce Business Analyst & Admin (m/f/d) – Field Service, you are responsible for analyzing, shaping, documenting, and supporting the implementation of business requirements for the Technical Service stream within the global Customer Engagement ecosystem (Salesforce CRM), with a strong focus on Salesforce Field Service, Service Cloud and Platform capabilities.You act as the key interface between Technical Service stakeholders, Product Owners, technical teams, and regional or local CRM specialists. The role combines strong Business Analysis capabilities with hands-on Salesforce configuration knowledge. You translate business needs into clear, testable user stories and solution concepts and can independently implement approved no-code and low-code changes within the applicable governance framework.Your focus is on scalable, harmonized, and user-centered Technical Service solutions. You ensure that global processes can be adopted effectively across regions while enabling appropriate localization for market-specific operational and regulatory requirements. You contribute functional and technical expertise across case management, Work Order and Service Appointment Management, Field Service Mobile App configuration as well as Scheduling and Optimization.Your responsibilitiesBusiness Analysis and Requirements Engineering- Plan, facilitate, and document workshops, interviews, process-mapping sessions, and refinement meetings to analyze current processes, pain points, objectives, user needs, dependencies, risks, and expected business value.- Translate business needs into clear, complete, consistent, testable, and traceable epics, templates and capabilities while enabling justified, controlled localization, and identify improvements to agent productivity, first-contact resolution, response quality, process transparency, and customer experience.- Support the evaluation and responsible adoption of AI-enabled and automation capabilities for Customer Service and Field Service use cases, including Agentforce where applicable.Testing, Release, and Deployment Support- Define test scenarios and expected results from requirements and acceptance criteria; prepare and execute functional testing and support system integration, end-to-end, regression, and user acceptance testing.- Triage defects, clarify expected behavior, support root-cause analysis, and coordinate resolution with the appropriate teams.- enhancement demands.Stakeholder Collaboration and Enablement- Build trusted relationships with global and local Technical Service stakeholders, communicate effectively with business and technical audiences, and facilitate alignment and decisions by clearly presenting options, trade-offs, impacts, recommendations, and open points.- Collaborate with local CRM specialists on market adoption, training, and end-user support, providing expert guidance on complex or escalated topics and supporting process documentation, user guidance, release communications, training materials, and enablement concepts.- Contribute to cross-regional communities of practice and promote consistent Business Analysis and Salesforce configuration standards.Data, Reporting, and Operational Support- Ensure the quality, consistency, integrity, and appropriate use of Technical Service and cross-stream Platform data, including cases, accounts, work orders, assets, locations, and product items.- Define reporting requirements and create or support reports and dashboards for operational management, service-performance monitoring, adoption tracking, and continuous improvement; analyze incidents, user feedback, process performance, and platform usage to identify opportunities.- Provide expert-level functional support for complex or escalated Technical Service topics and coordinate with technical teams as required.Your qualifications- University degree in business administration, economics, information technology, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.- At least 5 years of professional experience in Business Analysis, CRM, Technical Service, commercial operations, or a related environment (preferably Pharma or Life Sciences), including at least 3 years of hands-on Salesforce Field Service experience as a Business Analyst, Functional Consultant, Administrator, or in a comparable role.- Proven experience in requirements elicitation, process analysis, workshop facilitation, user-story writing, acceptance criteria, backlog refinement, and stakeholder alignment.- Hands-on knowledge of Salesforce declarative configuration and low-code capabilities, including Salesforce Flow, with the ability to implement controlled changes without code and assess automation impacts, error handling, maintainability, and testing needs.- Solid understanding of Field Service and Service Cloud concepts, including Case Management, Work Order and Service Appointment Management, Scheduling and Optimization, and Field Service Mobile App capabilities.- Experience with agile delivery methods and tools such as JIRA and Confluence, as well as functional testing, UAT preparation and execution, defect triage, release support, and hypercare.- Understanding of jobs.description: About usAirbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.Job descriptionIn order to support the Test Means Design Team in Bremen, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for aPMT Leader Test Means (d/f/m)The Test Means Design Team in Bremen is one of four transnational Design Offices focused on Test Means Design and Integration for Flight Test (FTI) and Lab Test Means (LTM). FTI prepares development aircraft to perform tests essential for the development, improvement, and certification of our aircraft. A key challenge for LTM is aligning industrial bench standards with the aircraft environment of the examinees.The Bremen team is responsible for the customized engineering of Functional Electric (FE) and Test System Installation (ESI/MSI). Working across several programs and MSNs, team members are required to have strong proficiency in the relevant toolsets.In this role, your primary responsibility will be to provide operational support to the Design Office regarding Process, Methods, and Tools (PMT), specifically for Functional Electrical design activities. Additionally, you will serve as the PMT focal point for the specification, testing, and deployment of new solutions within a transnational framework.Your locationBremen is a charming city full of history in the northwest of Germany. In addition to being one of the country’s greenest cities, it offers wonderful sights, a rich culture, urban flair and culinary delights. It’s also a great place for seaside lovers, being located just an hour’s drive from the North Sea coast.Our Benefits for You- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.Your tasks and responsibilities- Starting with operational support to the FE team in their day-to-day work, specifically regarding Process, Methods, and Tooling issues- Acting as the focal point for all FE design toolsets, across all programs and National Companies (NatCos)- Participating in the deployment of any new Airbus tools within the various teams (Design, Business, etc.)- Serving as a Business Representative within the context of digital transformation projects- Acting as a key reference point for the usage of FE design tools- Gathering requirements to support the creation of new tools- Regular travels between Airbus Sites are expectedDesired skills and qualifications- You have a degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Aeronautics or equivalent- You already have ideally practical experience in Design or Functional Electric and corresponding PLM Toolsets, like: CAPITAL, CORE ELEC, CIRCE, SEE XP, ESDCR, CCD, TAKSY, ELSY- Knowledge of Electrical Functional Design would be a valuable asset for your application.- You are autonomous, inquisitive, and proactive- You are open-minded and possess strong analytical and synthesis skills, with the ability to step back from day-to-day activities to propose new ideas- Working at Airbus involves operating in an international environment; therefore, you must be able to communicate fluently in English. (French is a plus)- You have already solid experience in project management and are capable of switching between different topics while maintaining a strong team spirit- Good knowledge of tool development and LBIP+ Methodology is an assetNot a 100% match? No worries! jobs.occupation: Scientific Coordinator (m/f/d) International Max Planck Research School for Ultrafast Imaging & Stru (Projektkoordinator/in (kaufmännisch))
jobs.description: The Max Planck Society is one of the world’s leading research organizations. Its institutes conduct cutting-edge basic research in the natural sciences, life sciences, social sciences and humanities for the benefit of society. Located in Science City Hamburg Bahrenfeld, the Max Planck Institute for the Structure and Dynamics of Matter (MPSD) investigates the properties and dynamics of matter on the elementary timescales of atomic and electronic motion. Its interdisciplinary research combines experimental and theoretical approaches, with a particular focus on ultrafast phenomena, quantum materials and advanced imaging methods. The International Max Planck Research School for Ultrafast Imaging & Structural Dynamics (IMPRS-UFAST) is a joint initiative of the MPSD, Universität Hamburg, Deutsches Elektronen-Synchrotron (DESY) and European XFEL. It provides outstanding doctoral researchers from around the world with a structured and interdisciplinary training environment at the Hamburg-Bahrenfeld research campus.To coordinate and further develop this international doctoral program, the MPSD is seeking a highly motivatedScientific Coordinator (m/f/d) International Max Planck Research School for Ultrafast Imaging & Structural Dynamics (IMPRS-UFAST)The position offers an excellent opportunity to apply academic experience and transferable skills in a new professional context and to develop a career in science management. We are looking for a candidate who understands the opportunities and challenges of doctoral research from personal experience and is motivated to use this knowledge to support and further develop the next generation of international researchers.Your position- Training Programme - Develop and coordinate a semester-based curriculum of scientific courses and transferable-skills training in close collaboration with IMPRS Fellows and Principal Investigators.- Plan and organize workshops, retreats, networking events and career-development activities tailored to the needs of doctoral researchers.- Regularly evaluate and further develop the training program to foster interdisciplinary exchange and professional development.- Annual International Doctoral Recruitment - Coordinate the annual international recruitment and application process, from developing and publishing doctoral projects and launching the call for applications to organizing the selection symposium, conducting interviews and coordinating final admissions.- Doctoral Mentoring and Career Development - Support doctoral researchers throughout their time in the programme, from admission and onboarding through to completion, serving as a trusted contact for programme-related, administrative and career matters.- Develop and coordinate initiatives that help doctoral researchers explore and prepare for career opportunities beyond the PhD.- IMPRS-UFAST Office and Programme Administration - Oversee the day-to-day operations of the IMPRS-UFAST Office and coordinate communication, collaboration and networking among doctoral researchers, academic partners and committees, national and international partner institutions, and the MPSD administration.- Serve as a member of the IMPRS-UFAST Executive Board and contribute to programme governance by preparing and coordinating meetings, implementing decisions, and overseeing reports, evaluations and programme documentation.- Coordinate the programme budget and oversee the website, guidelines, application information, records and communication channels, while contributing to quality assurance, alumni relations, academic networking and the strategic development of IMPRS-UFAST.Your background and skills- A completed doctorate in the natural sciences; postdoctoral experience is an advantage, but not a requirement.- A strong understanding of doctoral research, the challenges and opportunities of an academic career, and the German higher-education and research environment.- A genuine interest in science management and in applying your academic experience and expertise in a broader professional context.- Strong communication, coordination and project-management skills, demonstrated through experience in research, teaching, mentoring, event organisation or collaborative projects.- A proactive, independent and structured approach to work, combined with creativity, initiative and a strong ability to work collaboratively.- Excellent written and spoken English; very good German language skills or a willingness to develop them further are desirable.- Intercultural sensitivity and the ability to communicate and collaborate effectively with doctoral researchers, senior scientists, administrative colleagues and external partners.- Previous experience in science management is an advantage, but not a requirement. We particularly welcome candidates with an academic background who are ready to broaden their professional perspective and bring their scientific expertise, international experience and organisational strengths into a new professional context.Our offer- A varied and rewarding role at the intersection of science, doctoral education, career development and science management, with scope for initiative, professional growth and the opportunity to contribute your own ideas to the further development of IMPRS-UFAST.- An international, interdisciplinary and collegial working environment at the Science City Hamburg Bahrenfeld research campus, with a modern workplace and opportunities for collaboration across institutions.- A wide range of training and professional-development opportunities.- A family-friendly working environment and active support in balancing work, family and personal life.- A subsidy for the Profiticket as a Germany ticket.- Attractive remuneration and social benefits in accordance with the German public pay scale (TVöD Bund), depending on qualifications and professional experience.- Supplementary pension provision through VBL.- An initial contract for two years, with the possibility of permanent employment thereafter.- The Max Planck Society is committed to gender equality, diversity and inclusion. We welcome applications from all backgrounds. The Max Planck Society also aims to increase the number of employees with disabilities and therefore expressly encourages applications from qualified individuals with disabilities.Your applicationPlease submit the following documents through our online application portal by 26 October 2026.- a letter of motivation outlining your interest in science management, doctoral training and the development of IMPRS-UFAST- your curriculum vitae- copies of your relevant university degrees and doctoral certificate- relevant employment certificates or references- a publication list, if applicableFor questions regarding the position, please contact Dr. Neda Lotfiomran (neda.lotfiomran@mpsd.mpg.de (https://mailto:neda.lotfiomran@mpsd.mpg.de) ) . Detailed information about the Max Planck Institute for the Structure and Dynamics of Matter can be found at http://www.mpsd.mpg.de (http://www.mpsd.mpg.de/) .We look forward to your application.Homeoffice:Umfang: Nach Vereinbarung

The Max Planck Institute for Solar System Research (MPS) in Göttingen is one of the world's leading research institutions in the fields of solar physics and planetary research, with approximately 300 employees. The interdisciplinary research focus lies in the investigation of the development, diversity, and dynamics of planets, moons, small bodies, the sun, and solar-like stars.
